extra.description: Ragged-batch CoW concurrency capacity and bandwidth-bound decode throughput
extra.mode: capacity model + modeled throughput (no GPU on host)
extra.geometry: 32 layers x 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim = 16384 elems/token per K or V tensor
extra.throughput_model: bandwidth-bound: bytes_per_us = dram_total_bytes/duration_us from p7_ncu_bandwidth fused rows at the matching seq_len; tok/s = N*1e6/((shared + N*private)/bytes_per_us). Upper bound: ignores attention/softmax compute and assumes ideal CoW page sharing.
